- Containerized services with Docker and orchestrated local and staging deployments; used Git for branching strategies and automated builds.
- Built Kafka-backed event pipelines to stream telemetry data into processing microservices, enabling near real-time analytics and improving data freshness SLA from 24h to under 5 minutes.
